SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) = 'beverage'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
